summary: Paylocity Holding Corp filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, announcing its board approved a $1 billion increase to its existing share repurchase program, supplementing the $350 million remaining as of March 31, 2026. The program allows repurchases via open market, 10b5-1 plans, or private transactions, with timing and amount dependent on market conditions and other factors. No specific price or expiration was set; the program does not obligate repurchase of any shares and may be modified or suspended. This capital return signals management's view of undervaluation; watch for actual buyback pace to gauge commitment.
